about: The measurements of structures on the hex grid, in metres (formal/hex-houses.md § Sizes). Change them here, not in the routines; tests/hexhouses.loft checks the rules still hold with them. A hex step is 1.5 m, fixed by the grid. Each kind of wall has its own thickness: an outer wall, an inner wall between rooms and a fence (the inner wall and the fence are not drawn yet; their numbers are first guesses for the owner to set). The terrain's measurements: a storey (one layer of the square world), how wide a hillside is between two terraces, how wide a stream's bank, and how far round a house the ground blends back to its own height.
